releases_release_id: Unique Discogs identifier for this specific release/pressing.
releases_release_status: Moderation status of the release entry (e.g. Accepted, Draft).
releases_release_country: Country the release was issued in.
releases_release_released: Release date as recorded (format varies: full date, year-month, or just year).
releases_release_notes: Free-text notes about this specific pressing (e.g. matrix info, pressing plant, limited-edition details).
releases_release_data_quality: Discogs community data-quality flag for this entry (e.g. Correct, Needs Vote, Needs Major Changes).
releases_release_master_id: Discogs master release ID this pressing belongs to, linking it to the abstract work.
releases_release_master_id_is_main_relea: Whether this pressing is the master's designated main/representative release ("true"/"false").
release_genres_genre: Broad genre tag(s) for the release. A JSON array when multiple exist.
release_styles_style: More specific style tag(s) for the release. A JSON array when multiple exist.
artists_artist_id: Discogs ID of a main (billed) artist on the release.
artists_artist_name: Name of a main (billed) artist on the release.
artists_artist_anv: Artist Name Variation: how the artist is credited on this specific release, if different from their canonical artists_artist_name.
artists_artist_join: Join phrase connecting this artist credit to the next one (e.g. "&", "Featuring", "vs.") when multiple main artists are credited.
extraartists_artist_id: Discogs ID of a credited contributor who is not a main artist (producer, engineer, remixer, etc.).
extraartists_artist_name: Name of a credited contributor who is not a main artist.
extraartists_artist_anv: Artist Name Variation for the contributor named in extraartists_artist_name, if credited differently on this release.
extraartists_artist_role: Role/credit of the contributor named in extraartists_artist_name (e.g. "Producer", "Mixed By").
extraartists_artist_tracks: Which track(s) this contributor's credit applies to (e.g. "1, 3-5"), when a credit doesn't apply to the whole release.
release_labels_label_name: Name of a label this release was issued on. A JSON array when co-released across labels.
release_labels_label_id: Discogs label ID corresponding to release_labels_label_name.
release_labels_label_catno: Catalog number assigned by the label in release_labels_label_name.
release_series_series_name: Name of a numbered series this release belongs to, when Discogs tracks it as part of one.
release_series_series_id: Discogs series ID corresponding to release_series_series_name.
release_series_series_catno: Catalog number within the series named in release_series_series_name.
release_formats_format_name: Physical/digital format of this release (e.g. Vinyl, CD, Cassette, File).
release_formats_format_qty: Quantity of items in this format grouping (e.g. "2" for a 2xLP).
release_formats_format_text: Free-text format notes as printed by the submitter (e.g. "180g", "Gatefold").
format_descriptions_description: Additional format descriptors (e.g. "12\"", "33 \u2153 RPM", "Album", "Limited Edition"). A JSON array when multiple exist.
companies_company_id: Discogs company ID for the company named in companies_company_name.
companies_company_name: Name of a company involved in production/distribution (pressing plant, distributor, etc.).
companies_company_catno: Catalog/reference number assigned by the company named in companies_company_name, when documented.
companies_company_entity_type: Numeric Discogs code for the company's role, paired with companies_company_entity_type_name.
companies_company_entity_type_name: Role of the company in companies_company_name (e.g. "Pressed By", "Distributed By").
release_identifiers_identifier_type: Type of an identifier recorded for the release (e.g. Barcode, Matrix / Runout).
release_identifiers_identifier_value: Value of the identifier named in release_identifiers_identifier_type.
release_identifiers_identifier_descripti: Free-text clarification of the identifier (e.g. "Runout locked groove"), when documented.
tracklist_track_title: Title of a track in the tracklist.
tracklist_track_duration: Duration of a track, as printed (format varies, typically MM:SS).
